author: GamingBolt
description:
Windrose has managed to carve a name for itself among the best pirate-themed games out there, despite being an early access title with a long way to go before completion. But why, then, has it accrued a fairly large number of players who seemingly can’t get enough of it? 

We’re here to throw our hat in the ring and tell you why this one can be hard to put down. Is it the procedurally-generated worlds it gives you? Or the fact that you can join your buddies as you pillage and plunder enemy ships? What’s the hidden treasure that makes this one so addictive? Join us as we set sail into the unknown and give you reasons to start an adventure that could evolve into an experience like no other.
title: Why Are Millions of Gamers Addicted To Windrose?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Between killing mechanical dragons, commandeering your own, piloting a mech, skydiving from floating abyssal islands, and finding out that Beloth the Darksworn indeed has hands, Crimson Desert feels like the experience that just keeps giving. Even if you pour over 100 hours into the game, there's so much to do, and the developer keeps adding new features, like new mounts. Later this week, there will be difficulty settings, so you can start a fresh playthrough and challenge yourself like never before.

But what if you're looking for a break? What if you're looking out at a grateful Pywel and wanting a vacation from being a good boy scout? As enjoyable as diving into a massive open world like this can be, there's something to say about taking a vacation and enjoying something that's, well, the opposite. title: After 100 Hours of Crimson Desert, Pragmata Is Exactly The Kind of Game I Needed

author: GamingBolt
description:
Forza Horizon 6 is promising to be Playground Games’ most-accomplished entry in their now-long-running arcade, open world racing series. The studio has taken us through some picturesque landscapes already, but FH6’s Japanese setting is poised to bring the most radically diverse roadways yet. But, whilst arguably the racing already hit the ceiling for innovation in Forza Horizon 5, Playground has still found ways to tweak the driving experience beyond Horizon 6’s heavy focus on visual and audio overhauls. 

So, whilst there’s lots to cover on what you see and hear, here’s fifteen of the biggest differences Forza Horizon 6 brings over its predecessor, from progression, to exploration and customisation.
title: Forza Horizon 6 vs Forza Horizon 5: Here Are The 14 Biggest Differences You Need To Know
